originalTitle: U.S. stock futures steady ahead of midterms; Apple dips after mixed earnings
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose slightly on Monday evening, with Wall Street eying some recovery after logging a weak start to November on sustained losses in technology shares.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose slightly on Monday evening, with Wall Street eying some recovery after logging a weak start to November on sustained losses in technology shares.

Gains in futures were also limited by a drop in Apple after concerns over surging memory costs offset an otherwise strong quarterly showing from the iPhone maker.

Focus was squarely on the midterm elections, with in-person voting set to begin on Tuesday.

S&P 500 Futures rose 0.15% to 7,585.50 points by 18:57 ET (23:57 GMT). Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 0.3% to 28,208.50 points, while Dow Jones Futures rose 0.06% to 52,166.0 points.

Futures steadied after a negative session on Wall Street, as losses in tech showed few signs of slowing after an extended rout in October.

Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic added to pressure on tech valuations after it disclosed a sharp deterioration in revenue growth in the third quarter, raising more questions over the profitability of AI.

Apple dips as memory warning, soft services offset record earnings

Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) fell as much as 3% in aftermarket trade after the iPhone maker forecast slightly below-consensus gross margin for the current quarter, citing mounting headwinds from soaring global memory prices.

Apple guided gross margin of 45% to 46%, below Street expectations of 46.9%.

CEO John Ternus, who took over from Tim Cook in September, said rising memory costs were "unprecedented," and that prices were likely to increase in this quarter and beyond.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

The tech giant guided a slowdown in revenue from its Services segment, which is its second-biggest breadwinner behind the iPhone. Apple flagged headwinds from unfavorable currency markets, regulations, and a sustained slowdown in mobile gaming.

Still, Apple beat top and bottom-line estimates for the September quarter, aided chiefly by strong sales of its new iPhone 18 line. The company's first foldable– Duo– was also launched to outsized demand in October, although Apple warned that supplies of the foldable were likely to be constrained.

Apple announced a new version of its Siri voice assistance, but offered few cues on its plans to integrate more artificial intelligence in its services.

The iPhone maker is widely regarded as a large-cap hedge against artificial intelligence, given its relatively low exposure to the technology. This benefited the company's shares in recent weeks, amid a broader AI-driven wipeout in tech.

Apple recently overtook Nvidia to reclaim its spot as the most valuable publicly listed company in the world.

Among other aftermarket movers, Palantir Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:PLTR) fell 3.1% in aftermarket trade after its blowout third-quarter earnings still failed to meet some loft expectations. The AI and data firm also faced profit-taking after a strong run-up this year.

Wall St cautious ahead of midterm elections

Caution before the midterm elections kept Wall Street on edge, especially as President Donald Trump and the Republican party face an uphill battle.

In-person voting is set to begin on Tuesday.

Recent polls showed the Republicans risk losing their majority in both chambers of Congress, amid growing voter discontent over high fuel prices and a protracted war with Iran.

A Republican loss in Congress presents more headwinds for Trump in enacting his agenda. The president is also expected to resort to more executive measures in such a scenario, heralding much more regulatory uncertainty for markets.

chineseTitle: 美国股指期货在中期选举前保持稳定；苹果公司盈利好坏参半后股价下跌
chineseSummary: Investing.com——美国股指期货周一晚间小幅上涨，华尔街在科技股持续下跌导致 11 月份开局疲弱后，预计将有所复苏。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——美国股指期货周一晚间小幅上涨，华尔街在科技股持续下跌导致 11 月份开局疲弱后，预计将有所复苏。

还在猜测哪些股票会跑赢大盘？我们的人工智能投资组合每月更新一次，表现优于标准普尔 500 指数 118%。查看本月列表 »

由于对内存成本飙升的担忧抵消了 iPhone 制造商原本强劲的季度业绩，苹果股价下跌也限制了期货涨幅。

焦点完全集中在中期选举上，现场投票定于周二开始。

截至东部时间 18:57（格林威治标准时间 23:57），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.15% 至 7,585.50 点。纳斯达克100期货上涨0.3%至28,208.50点，道琼斯期货上涨0.06%至52,166.0点。

华尔街股市下跌后，期货企稳，因为科技股的跌幅在 10 月份的长期暴跌后几乎没有放缓的迹象。

人工智能初创公司 Anthropic 披露第三季度收入增长急剧恶化后，加大了科技股估值的压力，引发了更多关于人工智能盈利能力的质疑。

苹果因内存警告而下跌，软服务抵消了创纪录的盈利

苹果公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL）在售后市场交易中下跌了 3%，此前这家 iPhone 制造商预测本季度的毛利率略低于市场普遍预期，原因是全球内存价格飙升带来的阻力越来越大。

苹果预计毛利率为 45% 至 46%，低于华尔街预期的 46.9%。

9 月份接替蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的首席执行官约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 表示，内存成本的上涨是“史无前例的”，并且价格可能在本季度及以后上涨。

不确定在盈利之前买什么？在业绩下滑后，我们的 AI 最近的财报前电话会议带来了 +77% 至 +118% 的涨幅。查看本月收益精选 »

这家科技巨头引导其服务部门的收入放缓，该部门是仅次于 iPhone 的第二大收入来源。苹果公司指出了不利的货币市场、监管以及移动游戏持续放缓带来的不利因素。

尽管如此，苹果在 9 月季度的营收和利润仍超出了预期，这主要得益于新款 iPhone 18 系列的强劲销售。该公司的首款可折叠手机 Duo 也在 10 月份推出，以满足巨大的需求，尽管苹果警告称可折叠手机的供应可能会受到限制。

苹果宣布推出新版 Siri 语音助手，但并未透露其在服务中整合更多人工智能的计划。

鉴于该公司对人工智能的敞口相对较低，该公司被广泛认为是对冲人工智能的大盘股。最近几周，在人工智能驱动的科技领域出现更广泛的损失之际，这使该公司的股价受益。

苹果最近超越英伟达，重新成为全球市值最高的上市公司。

在其他售后市场推动者中，Palantir Technologies Inc（纳斯达克股票代码：PLTR）在售后市场交易中下跌 3.1%，因为其井喷的第三季度盈利仍未能达到一些高预期。这家人工智能和数据公司在今年强劲上涨后也面临获利了结。

华尔街在中期选举前持谨慎态度

中期选举前的谨慎态度让华尔街紧张不安，尤其是在唐纳德·特朗普总统和共和党面临一场艰苦的战斗之际。

现场投票定于周二开始。

最近的民意调查显示，由于选民对高油价和与伊朗的旷日持久的战争日益不满，共和党有可能失去国会两院的多数席位。

共和党在国会的失利给特朗普制定议程带来了更多阻力。在这种情况下，预计总统还将采取更多行政措施，这预示着市场监管的不确定性将大大增加。
